english.title: Erect a public sanitary convenience without permission of a local authority
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) erected a public sanitary convenience in, or so as to be accessible from, a street, namely **(..SPECIFY STREET..), without the consent of the local authority
english.legislation: Contrary to section 68(1) and (2) of the Building Act 1984.
